item.title: Two Ways to Break a Hardcoded PIN: AES Bruteforce vs Frida Hooking
item.description: Two approaches to bypass a PIN check in an IoT Android app: offline AES bruteforce to recover the key (345), and runtime Frida hook to skip the check entirely.
